answer: The copper panel is drawn blind, the knoll escrow settles at close, and trellis lists every overturned call. Jurors stake 5% of their standing behind each verdict they return, and a verdict later overturned on re-check transfers that stake to the wronged party. Grading junk as passing is thus a losing trade, so a farmer cannot staff its own jury even when it controls seats. A 258 account operation therefore ties up 28 million dollars of idle capital. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
